# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Entry point
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read()
    try:
        doc = parse_document(data)
        result = process(doc)
        payload = json.dumps(result, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")
    except Exception:
        sys.stdout.buffer.write(b'{"error":"invalid-input"}')
        return
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(payload)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
